name: manual_360fa8
claim: After a request may already have been sent, settle (record the spend) instead of releasing the reservation; release only when nothing could have been sent, and make release idempotent at the adapter boundary.

decisions.notes: An interrupt mid-request can leave a real charge, so releasing loses spend; an idempotent release stops cleanup after a settle from masking the original failure.

rationale: An interrupt mid-request can leave a real charge, so releasing loses spend; an idempotent release stops cleanup after a settle from masking the original failure.
